description: Free vehicle history check against the official Czech vehicle registry (Registr silničních vozidel) by 17-character VIN: owner count and ownership timeline (companies named with IČO, private persons anonymous), STK inspection history with results, import origin, deregistration episodes, seized-document flags and technical specs. The registry has NO mileage data and NO license-plate lookup. Unknown VINs fall back to a rate-limited live registry lookup without timelines.
name: check_vehicle_by_vin
